mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q01.stem: KYT action goals specify responsibility and concrete actions.
reasons: True is correct. Make actions executable and checkable.
False is inappropriate. Make actions executable and checkable.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q02.stem: Heinrich's figures guarantee the next accident probability in every workplace.
reasons: True is incorrect. The ratio is not one accident probability common to all workplaces.
False is correct. The ratio is not one accident probability common to all workplaces.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q03.stem: A fixed shelf location removes checks for mixed items.
reasons: True is incorrect. Fixed-item control also requires checking what is placed there.
False is correct. Fixed-item control also requires checking what is placed there.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q04.stem: Compare a color reference and part under the same light source.
reasons: True is correct. Different light sources change perceived color, so align conditions.
False is inappropriate. Different light sources change perceived color, so align conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q05.stem: Slightly out-of-range pH permits any operator-selected chemical addition.
reasons: True is incorrect. Unauthorized acid/alkali addition can cause heat or splashing.
False is correct. Unauthorized acid/alkali addition can cause heat or splashing.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q06.stem: Every coating has the same protective effect on every substrate.
reasons: True is incorrect. Effects depend on substrate/coating combinations and environment.
False is correct. Effects depend on substrate/coating combinations and environment.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q07.stem: Matching buff shape can still give different results with different material or structure.
reasons: True is correct. Hardness, shape retention and conformability affect processing.
False is inappropriate. Hardness, shape retention and conformability affect processing.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q08.stem: Tool wear affects robotic polishing quality too.
reasons: True is correct. Automated processes also respond to wear, holding and positioning changes.
False is inappropriate. Automated processes also respond to wear, holding and positioning changes.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q09.stem: Aluminium's natural film remains undamaged forever under any treatment.
reasons: True is incorrect. The natural film is thin and can be damaged by external action.
False is correct. The natural film is thin and can be damaged by external action.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q10.stem: PVD and CVD have different main film-formation mechanisms.
reasons: True is correct. PVD uses physical deposition; CVD uses chemical reactions.
False is inappropriate. PVD uses physical deposition; CVD uses chemical reactions.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q11.stem: Add closed-loop voltage changes while ignoring all signs.
reasons: True is incorrect. Align the direction around the loop and supply/drop signs.
False is correct. Align the direction around the loop and supply/drop signs.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q12.stem: Record sample time and liquid temperature with pH results.
reasons: True is correct. Different temperatures or sampling times can change comparison conditions.
False is inappropriate. Different temperatures or sampling times can change comparison conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q13.stem: Heat from strong pressure can cause polishing burns.
reasons: True is correct. Increased frictional heat can discolor the surface.
False is inappropriate. Increased frictional heat can discolor the surface.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q14.stem: Hydrometer contact with the container wall has no effect.
reasons: True is incorrect. Wall contact obstructs free floating.
False is correct. Wall contact obstructs free floating.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q15.stem: Check electrolyte presence as well as dissimilar-metal contact.
reasons: True is correct. Electrolyte conditions also matter alongside metal contact.
False is inappropriate. Electrolyte conditions also matter alongside metal contact.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q16.stem: Every factor on a cause-and-effect diagram is a confirmed cause.
reasons: True is incorrect. The diagram expands candidates; unconfirmed factors are hypotheses.
False is correct. The diagram expands candidates; unconfirmed factors are hypotheses.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q17.stem: Live-part measurement requires training and authority.
reasons: True is correct. Live measurement has shock and other hazards and requires specified conditions.
False is inappropriate. Live measurement has shock and other hazards and requires specified conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q18.stem: Experienced people may replace buffs while rotating.
reasons: True is incorrect. Replacement during rotation risks contact and entanglement.
False is correct. Replacement during rotation risks contact and entanglement.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q19.stem: Knowing the outer metal identifies every connection's performance.
reasons: True is incorrect. Outer-layer name alone cannot establish performance including contacts and underlayers.
False is correct. Outer-layer name alone cannot establish performance including contacts and underlayers.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q20.stem: Complete neutralization of 1 mol sulfuric acid corresponds to 2 mol NaOH.
reasons: True is correct. For complete neutralization,1 mol H₂SO₄ corresponds to 2 mol NaOH.
False is inappropriate. For complete neutralization,1 mol H₂SO₄ corresponds to 2 mol NaOH.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q21.stem: Equal thickness permits omitting every test for outdoor colored and wear parts alike.
reasons: True is incorrect. Thickness alone does not establish light or wear performance.
False is correct. Thickness alone does not establish light or wear performance.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q22.stem: Check the target and edition of an appearance limit sample.
reasons: True is correct. Reference samples require target, edition and storage-condition control.
False is inappropriate. Reference samples require target, edition and storage-condition control.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q23.stem: Complete-neutralization sulfuric acid at 0.30 mol/L is 0.15 equiv/L.
reasons: True is incorrect. Complete neutralization gives 0.30×2=0.60 equiv/L.
False is correct. Complete neutralization gives 0.30×2=0.60 equiv/L.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q24.stem: Use the specified lighting and direction for post-polishing appearance checks.
reasons: True is correct. Lighting and direction change scratch visibility.
False is inappropriate. Lighting and direction change scratch visibility.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q25.stem: Distinguish the indicator endpoint from the stoichiometric equivalence point.
reasons: True is correct. The observed endpoint and stoichiometric equivalence point are different concepts.
False is inappropriate. The observed endpoint and stoichiometric equivalence point are different concepts.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q26.stem: A hand-held small part needs no specified holding method.
reasons: True is incorrect. Being able to hold it does not guarantee safe restraint.
False is correct. Being able to hold it does not guarantee safe restraint.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q27.stem: For constant current, charge equals current multiplied by time.
reasons: True is correct. Q=I×t; A and seconds give C.
False is inappropriate. Q=I×t; A and seconds give C.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q28.stem: Identical tape colors mean identical chemical and thermal resistance.
reasons: True is incorrect. Materials and applicable temperatures can differ even with the same color.
False is correct. Materials and applicable temperatures can differ even with the same color.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q29.stem: One displayed symbol means no other hazards exist.
reasons: True is incorrect. Label omissions or other hazards can exist.
False is correct. Label omissions or other hazards can exist.

mfg1-surface-mock-10-theory-q30.stem: Check electron counts and charge balance when combining half-reactions.
reasons: True is correct. An equation cannot hold unless atom counts and charges also balance.
False is inappropriate. An equation cannot hold unless atom counts and charges also balance.
